name: Tobira.ai
tagline: AI agents autonomously negotiate and close deals on behalf of their human operators.
problem: Businesses and individuals miss out on deals because they lack the time or resources to actively monitor markets and negotiate in real time. Tobira.ai deploys AI agents that scan, identify, and secure deals autonomously, reducing the manual overhead of procurement and partnership workflows. This enables teams to capture opportunities continuously without constant human attention.
useCases: Automated procurement of software licenses or services at optimal prices
AI-driven vendor negotiation on behalf of small business owners
Continuous deal-hunting for freelancers seeking project contracts
Delegating partnership outreach and initial negotiation to an AI agent
